## TL;DR

Cross-surface mobile touch work for #1116 lands narrow-screen layout fixes for floating agent heads, a per-device visibility preference with More-sheet fallbacks, Releases and Activity readability tweaks, and focused tests. On viewports below 720px, page content and the integration status bar no longer reserve a right-hand column for the head stack; heads float over content when enabled. Defaults keep heads hidden on phones and visible on desktop, with localStorage override and a Settings switch. Agent launchers remain in the More sheet when heads are hidden.

## Work and rationale

Task #1116 follows the mobile shell (#1112), Work queue (#1113), task details (#1114), and Settings (#1115) slices. Those tasks established the 720px breakpoint, bottom tab bar, and narrow compositions. This pass audited remaining hover-only gaps, undersized targets, and horizontal squeeze on Activity feed lines, Releases action rows, and the global floating-head / integration-bar layout Nick called out in the task body.

The largest user-visible fix is stopping the ~70px inline-end reservation on narrow screens. Previously `#app` inherited `--page-inline-end-inset` from head size plus offsets, and `.main` used `max(16px, var(--page-inline-end-inset))`, shrinking an already narrow column. The integration bar mirrored that inset. The change sets `--page-inline-end-inset: 0px` inside the existing `719.98px` media block on `#app`, uses flat `16px` end padding on `.main`, and positions `.ibar-wrap` at `right: 12px`. Bottom scroll clearance still comes from `--page-bottom-inset` tied to the three-head stack height, so the last row of content is not trapped under heads or the tab bar.

Floating heads visibility is now a device preference, not server config. `useFloatingHeadsPreference` reads `repoos-floating-heads-visible` from localStorage; when unset, `visible` defaults to `!isNarrow` (off on phones, on at desktop widths). `FloatingHeads.vue` wraps the launcher stack in `v-if="visible"` but keeps teleported chat panels mounted so More-sheet launches still open CTO, Ross, or Debugger via window events (`repoos:open-cto`, `repoos:open-ross`, existing debugger event). `MobileTabs.vue` lists those three actions in the More sheet only when heads are hidden, using full-width tappable rows (`min-height: 52px` from existing mobile-more styles).

Settings exposes the preference under Themes as “Floating agent buttons” with the shared `Switch` and `data-test-id="floating-heads-setting"`, plus copy on narrow widths that points users to More when hidden.

Releases received a narrow media block: column-stacked header actions, 44px minimum touch targets on links and primary buttons, and `overflow-wrap: anywhere` on meta and blocker text so configured and empty states do not force horizontal scroll. Activity (dashboard feed) uses matching wrap rules on `.feed-msg` and `.feed-meta` below 720px.

#1069 last-activity touch gestures were not reopened; existing `data-touch-tip` behavior and tests in `easter-eggs-1058-card-activity.test.ts` already cover tap, long-press, and `pointercancel`. No global tooltip host changes were made.

## Approaches tried

The implementation aligned narrow layout tokens on the same `719.98px` breakpoint as `useResponsiveLayout` and refreshed IntegrationStatusBar media queries from `760px` to `720px` so shell, bar, and content agree. An alternative of keeping a reduced inset instead of zero was rejected because the task explicitly required full-width content with heads overlaying.

For agent access when heads are hidden, duplicating navigation routes was avoided; custom events into `FloatingHeads` match how the debugger already opened from elsewhere and keep panel state in one place.

## Challenges and blockers

Prior engineer turns left WIP checkpoint commits with the core diff; this session verified completeness, declared review shots on the canonical board via `repoos update` (CLI warns when run from a linked worktree), and ran the scoped gate.

Shot declaration for “heads shown” on a phone width needs a short step sequence: open Settings from the tab bar, toggle the switch, return to Work, then highlight `.floating-heads .stack`, because the default on narrow is hidden.

## Key learnings

Reserving horizontal space for `position: fixed` controls that already float is costly on ~390px viewports; overlaying while keeping bottom inset is the pattern used on Work and now generalized via `#app` tokens.

Per-device UI preferences belong in localStorage with composition-aware defaults, not `repoos.toml`, especially when desktop users expect heads on and phone users need the width unless they opt in.

Regression tests for layout can stay static (source/CSS assertions) for insets and More-sheet wiring, while `page-height-browser.test.ts` was updated so narrow viewports expect the integration bar and heads to overlap horizontally without clipping past the viewport edge.
